title: Blue Elephant Royal Thai Cooking Class
description: Master the intricacies of Royal Thai cuisine inside a beautifully restored century-old mansion in the heart of Bangkok's historic district.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The Blue Elephant Royal Thai Cooking Class, founded by Chef Nooror Somany Steppe, offers a 4-hour morning culinary experience in a beautifully restored century-old mansion in Bangkok's historic district. Participants learn to prepare four complex dishes, including Massaman Curry, after a market visit to Bang Rak.
> *   This luxury experience includes an expert chef-led market tour, a Tuk Tuk ride back to the colonial-style mansion, and a formal seated lunch in the grand dining room. AGS clients receive priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers.
> *   The class operates year-round, requires advance booking, and has a low physical demand, making it an elegant and educational addition to a luxury itinerary. It is best paired with a relaxed afternoon before a Chao Phraya river cruise.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Master the intricacies of Royal Thai cuisine inside a beautifully restored century-old mansion in the heart of Bangkok's historic district.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Founded by Chef Nooror Somany Steppe, a pioneer in elevating Thai cuisine to global fine-dining standards, the Blue Elephant is an institution. It bridges the gap between fiercely guarded royal family recipes and accessible, high-end culinary education.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Your morning begins at the Bang Rak morning market, accompanied by an expert chef who explains the foundational herbs and spices of Thai cooking. You return to the colonial-style mansion via a short Tuk Tuk ride. 

Inside a state-of-the-art kitchen, you will prepare four complex dishes, such as Massaman Curry from scratch, learning to balance sweet, sour, salty, and spicy profiles. The session concludes with a seated, formal lunch in the grand dining room.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Elegant, Educational, Historic |
| **Duration** | 4 Hours (Morning) |
| **Physical Demand** | Low (Cooking) |

## Pairing Chef Nooror’s Century-Old Sathorn Mansion With Bangkok Fairways & River Stays
Housed inside the historic 1903 Thai Chine Building on South Sathorn Road—directly adjacent to the Surasak BTS station and less than 15 minutes from [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) and 20 minutes via river boat or expressway from [Riva Surya Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/riva-surya-bangkok/)—the **Blue Elephant Royal Thai Cooking School** is Bangkok’s benchmark culinary masterclass. On a [Bangkok & Hua Hin](/tours/the-bangkok-and-hua-hin-fairways/) or [Thailand Ultimate Golf](/tours/thailand-royal-siam/) itinerary, groups integrate Blue Elephant in two ways:
1. **Parallel Morning for Non-Golfing Partners With Shared Mansion Lunch:** While the golfers tee off at 07:30 at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or [Bangkok Golf Club](/courses/thailand/bangkok-golf-club/), non-golfing spouses join Blue Elephant’s instructor at 08:45 AM to tour the Bang Rak morning wet market and prepare four Royal Thai dishes—reuniting with the golfers at 1:00 PM inside the mansion’s teakwood dining room for a private feast.
2. **Afternoon Session (1:30 PM–5:00 PM) After Dawn Patrol Golf:** Skip the morning market walk and step straight into the air-conditioned culinary amphitheater after a morning round, pounding fresh curry pastes before dining on your creations for an early dinner.

## Royal Recipe Pedigree & Take-Home Culinary Kit
* **Four-Course Royal Thai Curriculum:** Under Chef Nooror Somany Steppe’s brigade, guests master dishes such as *Massaman Lamb or Beef Curry* with sweet potatoes and roasted peanuts, *Tom Kha Gai* infused with young galangal, green mango salad with crispy catfish, and *Tod Mun Pla* fish cakes.
* **Custom Apron & Spice Folio:** Every participant receives a woven Blue Elephant culinary bag, recipe dossier, and export-sealed Thai curry pastes that clear Australian customs effortlessly.

faqs.q: Does Blue Elephant Cooking School in Bangkok offer both morning and afternoon classes for golfers?
faqs.a: Yes. The 8:45 AM morning class includes the guided Bang Rak market tour and lunch, while the 1:30 PM afternoon class focuses purely on hands-on cooking and early dinner—ideal after a morning round at Thai Country Club or Ballyshear.

faqs.q: How far is the Blue Elephant mansion from Sindhorn Kempinski and Bangkok's luxury hotels?
faqs.a: Located on South Sathorn Road in Bang Rak, the historic Blue Elephant mansion sits 12 to 15 minutes by private SUV from Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok and the Chao Phraya riverfront hotel district.

faqs.q: Can non-golfers cook in the morning and have the golfers join them for lunch at Blue Elephant?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Asia Golf Specialists reserves a private dining room inside the century-old Sathorn mansion so golfers returning from their morning round can sit down at 1:00 PM to enjoy the feast alongside the chefs.
